chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام): "Does the adulterer not commit adultery while he is a believer?" He said: "No. When he is upon her belly, faith is stripped from him. Then when he rises, it is returned to him. Then if he repeats, it is stripped away." I said: "But he intends to return." So he said: "How many there are who intend to return, yet never return to it ever again."

key_terms.أَبَدًا: ever; permanently in the expression of never returning
key_terms.الْإِيمَانُ: faith, in the sense of active believing condition
key_terms.سُلِبَ: was stripped away or taken from him

ai.seo_question: Does a believer retain iman while committing zina according to Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes zina as a state in which iman is removed from the sinner during the act, then returned afterward. It emphasizes both the gravity of major sin and the possibility that a person may intend to repeat a sin yet never actually return to it.
